proposals.before: He also impeached Prince Su Shiduo for monopolizing Grand Council affairs, hoarding power, and taking bribes; when war began Shiduo relied entirely on Hongzhang and thereby mishandled military timing. None of these memorials received a response.
proposals.after: He also impeached Prince Li Shiduo for monopolizing Grand Council affairs, hoarding power, and taking bribes; when war began Shiduo relied entirely on Hongzhang and thereby mishandled military timing. None of these memorials received a response.
proposals.reason: 禮親王 is Prince Li, not Prince Su (肅親王).

proposals.before: Baixi memorialized that Wu Jilun, prefect of Jizhou, be given fifth-rank minister status and made general instructor of the university.
proposals.after: Baixi memorialized that Wu Rulun, prefect of Jizhou, be given fifth-rank minister status and made general instructor of the university.
proposals.reason: 吳汝綸 is Wu Rulun; Jilun misreads 汝綸.

proposals.before: At that time an edict directed all ministers to take turns lecturing before the throne. Jianai composed lectures on the Four Books of the Book of Documents and presented them.
proposals.after: At that time an edict directed all ministers to take turns lecturing before the throne. Jianai composed lectures on the Book of Documents and the Four Books and presented them.
proposals.reason: 尚書四子書 means the Documents and the Four Books, not Four Books of the Documents.

decisions.reason: s0017 has 拜體仁閣大學士. 體仁閣 is Tiren Hall; "Titren" is a typographical corruption with no source support. The proposed replacement corrects only that hall name and leaves the rest of the accurate idiomatic wording intact.
The same focus unit 還京，拜體仁閣大學士 is mistranslated in the literal field as Titren Hall. Tiren Hall correctly romanizes 體仁閣; the rest of the literal sentence already matches the Chinese.
s0042 names 禮親王世鐸. 禮親王 is Prince Li; Prince Su would be 肅親王, which is not in the text. Changing Su to Li restores the correct princely title without altering the impeachment charges or outcome.
s0057 has 冀州知州吳汝綸. 汝綸 is Rulun, not Jilun; the proposed idiomatic restores the standard personal name while preserving the prefecture, honor, and university-instructor content.

s0023 has 尚書四子書講義: 尚書 (Book of Documents) and 四子書 (the Four Books) are coordinated titles, not "Four Books of the Book of Documents." The proposed literal matches that reading and the already-correct idiomatic.

Accepted r0004 shows the English personal name "Wu Jilun" was created by misreading 汝綸; the name claim remains source-based, but the English form must be Wu Rulun to match 吳汝綸 and the existing pinyin.
